Mayor and Kenosha County Executive to join company and community leaders in marking the milestone expansion

KENOSHA, Wis., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- G10 Fulfillment, a North American third-party logistics and fulfillment provider, will hold a ribbon-cutting ceremony celebrating the grand opening of its new distribution facility in Kenosha, Wisconsin, on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at 12345 38th Street.

The new 315,000-square-foot facility replaces G10's former Twin Lakes location and more than doubles the company's Midwest warehouse capacity. Positioned along the Chicago–Milwaukee freight corridor, the site supports large-scale order fulfillment and regional inventory distribution as part of G10's broader logistics network.

# Verst Logistics opens new Northern Kentucky Excellence Center

August 21, 2026

#### 20,119-square-foot facility brings company leadership and 75 employees together at Corporex’s CirclePort development

ERLANGER, Ky. (Aug. 20, 2026) — Verst Logistics has opened a new 20,119-square-foot office in Northern Kentucky, bringing its executive leadership and 75 employees under one roof as the third-party logistics provider continues its national expansion.

Verst, in partnership with Northern Kentucky-based real estate investment and development firm Corporex, held a grand opening and ribbon-cutting for the new Verst Logistics Excellence Center at Olympic Corporate Center II at CirclePort in Boone County.

The Class A office facility was designed to support the logistics company’s growth strategy and includes advanced audiovisual technology, an operations Logistics Hub and a large company lounge. The space is intended to increase collaboration among teams while supporting customer service and future growth.

# Qube celebrates a new home in Rocky Assets 

28 July 2026

Qube Bulk marked the official opening of its brand new warehouse facility on Tuesday, 28 July 2026, supporting critical mineral supply chains, warehousing, and transport services throughout Central Queensland.

The new Parkhurst depot on Monier Road, the culmination of a $14 million investment in Rockhampton, was officially opened by the Member for Rockhampton, Mrs Donna Kirkland MP, at a ribbon-cutting ceremony on site.

The new facility establishes a permanent footprint for Qube – Australia’s leading provider of integrated import and export logistics – in the region.

“Qube’s investment in Rockhampton is a really important vote of confidence,” Mrs Kirkland said.

“Close to a $15 million investment into our region speaks volumes. What it says is: Queensland is open for business.”

Qube’s General Manager – Mining Services, Sam Leszczynski, said the facility was a significant upgrade on the leased facility formerly occupied by Qube – and reflective of the importance of the region to Qube.

RGL prioritizes career development, Michelle Wellens said, while also offering paid opportunities for community volunteer work. Submitted Photo

 

Judith Munson

Contributor

October 5, 2026

APPLETON – RGL Logistics is making moves again.

The Green Bay-based company recently completed construction on a new warehouse at its Appleton campus, marking its 29th building to join its three-campus network. 

Michelle Wellens, director of transportation solutions and marketing, said the new building adds 427,500 square feet to the company’s total footprint of more than 4 million square feet, which covers all three RGL sites in Neenah, Green Bay and Appleton.

Wellens said the warehouse was built to create additional capacity and flexibility on RGL’s Appleton campus, while continuing to respond to customers’ needs.

# ProConnect Boosts Saudi supply chain with Riyadh Logistics center

- October 7, 2026 

 

ProConnect, the logistics and supply chain solutions business of Redington, has inaugurated its new logistics center in Riyadh. Image courtesy-ProConnect

ProConnect, the logistics and supply chain solutions business of Redington, has inaugurated its new logistics center in Riyadh, strengthening its presence in Saudi Arabia and expanding its ability to support customers with technology-enabled, end-to-end supply chain solutions.

Located within a 2.1 million sq. ft. logistics community, the new facility has approximately 400,000 sq. ft. of built-up space and has been designed to cater to the evolving logistics requirements of businesses across multiple industries.

The facility was inaugurated in the presence of representatives from the Ministry of Investment of Saudi Arabia (MISA), the Saudi Export Development Authority, the Embassy of India, customers, partners and members of the wider business community.
